description: This file defines the 'Template' class used for managing and rendering templates in the eGroupWare API, including methods for setting template variables, loading template files, handling blocks, and parsing templates with variable substitution.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class that provides template management features such as setting variables, loading template files, handling blocks within templates, and performing variable substitution.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the Template object with optional root directory and unknown variables handling method.

methods.name: set_root
methods.description: Sets the root directory where template files are located.

methods.name: set_unknowns
methods.description: Specifies how to handle undefined variables in templates ('remove', 'comment', 'keep').

methods.name: set_file
methods.description: Defines template files by handle and filename pairs.

methods.name: set_block
methods.description: Extracts a block of template identified by handle within a parent template and replaces it with a placeholder.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Sets template variables, either individually or as an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: subst
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in a template identified by handle and returns the resulting string.

methods.name: ppos
methods.description: Prints the substituted template content.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses templates by substituting handle(s) and storing the result in a target variable, with optional appending.

methods.name: pparser
methods.description: Prints the result of parsing templates.

methods.name: fp
methods.description: Performs parsing and immediately finishes (finalizes) to produce a string.

methods.name: pfp
methods.description: Performs parsing and outputs (prints) the final string.

methods.name: get_vars
methods.description: Retrieves all current template variables and their values.

methods.name: get_var
methods.description: Retrieves the value(s) of specified variable(s).

methods.name: get_undefined
methods.description: Returns all undefined variables in a template handle.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes a string by handling undefined variables according to the unknowns setting.

methods.name: p
methods.description: Prints the value of a variable after finalizing substitutions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the value of a variable after finalization.

methods.name: filename
methods.description: Resolves and returns a filename relative to the root, with checks for existence.

methods.name: varname
methods.description: Formats a variable name to be used as a placeholder in templates.

methods.name: loadfile
methods.description: Loads a template file by handle into the template system.

methods.name: halt
methods.description: Handles fatal errors, setting error message and optionally halting execution.

methods.name: haltmsg
methods.description: Outputs an error message related to template errors.
